[Breath Weapon](/Familiars.aspx?ID=19) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Advanced Player's Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=39) pg. 147

**Ability Type** Specific Familiar - Faerie Dragon

</column>

The faerie dragon breathes euphoric gas in a 10-foot cone. Each creature in the area must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. A creature that fails its save is [stupefied 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=37) and [slowed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=35) for 1d4 rounds; on a critical failure, the duration is 1 minute.
